player_prompt.intro:
D akken d Player {player_id} deg urar n {max_rounds} n tefriqt n Poker n Kuhn.
Tawila n Urar:
- Poker n Kuhn tesseqdac tifelwit n 3 n tikarḍi s J, Q, K (J d amectuḥ, K d ameqqran)
- Yal asselɣu yettura {ante} n tikarḍi, yerna yaweḍ 1 n tikarḍi deg yal tefriqt (xuṣṣen tikarḍi tettunefken war ma yella ussirem, ihi ur tezmireḍ ad ilɣeḍ tikarḍi tinnaḍt n ussinef-inek).
- Urar ikemmel i {max_rounds} n tefriqt
- Asselɣu i yesɛan aṭas n tikarḍi seld n tefriqt akk d netta i rebḥa
Tawila n Tidɣin:
- '[check]': Ffeɣ war ma tettureḍeḍ (kan ma ulac aɣellid ɣef uqerru)
- '[bet]': Rnu 1 n tikarḍi ɣer tfaska (kan ma ulac aɣellid ɣef uqerru)
- '[call]': Mmetchi aɣellid n ussinef-inek s rna 1 n tikarḍi ɣer tfaska
- '[fold]': Sserḥ aḍil-inek, terna tenneḍ ussinef-inek ad rebḥe tfaska

init_round.round_start: ### Tuddsa n tuddsa {current_round} seg {max_rounds} n tuddsi. Ajgu nnek d: '{player_card}'

showdown.showdown_summary: Anẓa: Tikarḍi n usselɣu {winner} {winner_card} tɣelleb tikarḍi n usselɣu {loser} {loser_card}. Asselɣu {winner} rebḥa tfaska n {pot_value} n tikarḍi.

outcome.draw: Deg taggara n {max_rounds} isurifen, sin imurar llan sεan yiwen uṭṭun n yicewwiqen.
